messages:
support_jen: Customer acme-therapeutics can't access models after the recent RBAC refactor. Console shows 'Access denied' on Models tab and CLI errors show 403 KMS decrypt failure. Ticket #4567 is escalated. Can ENG-Security take a look?

devon: Looking. Is this the post-rollout role rename we pushed last night? @eng_security FYI. What's the org/tenant id and a sample user?

support_jen: org: acct-acme-01, user: alice@acme.com, model: md-2026-prod. Error snippet from CLI: `ERROR: 403: permission denied: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt`

eng_security: On it. Checking audit logs and SA bindings now. @sre_bot can you run an IAM policy check for the KMS project and the service account `redwood-kms-bridge@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com`?

sre_bot: Ran automated check: serviceAccount:redwood-kms-bridge@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com is missing role `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on project `acme-prod-kms`. Also saw a failed SetIamPolicy event at 1767999900 referencing role renames.

devon: That would explain decrypt errors. Was there a rolesync/rename in the refactor? @maria any recent PRs that might have dropped legacy bindings?

maria: Yes — we merged infra PR that renamed `model-reader` -> `model.viewer` and flattened a bunch of bindings. KMS SA bindings were referenced by the old role name in a mapping script. Looks like the mapping script didn't include an alias for KMS roles.

devon: Quick mitigation: add the KMS encrypter/decrypter role to the SA and invalidate any cached keys. @oncall-bot can you apply a hotpatch IAM binding while we plan a proper fix?

oncall-bot: Applying hotpatch now...

```
# command run by oncall-bot
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding acme-prod-kms \
  --member=serviceAccount:redwood-kms-bridge@acme.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

eng_security: Hotpatch applied. Please verify with the customer and check that decrypt calls succeed.

support_jen: Customer reports console now loads models and the embedding calls work. They've confirmed access restored. Updating ticket and notifying account team.

devon: Root cause: roles refactor removed an alias mapping for KMS SA bindings. Action items: (1) add alias mapping in rolesync, (2) add an automated preflight that verifies critical SAs still have KMS roles, (3) run an org-wide audit for similar breakage.

maria: Filed INFRA-789 to add alias mapping and a preflight test. I'll schedule a follow-up rollout with the mapping fix. Question: do we want to revert the rename or just add compatibility aliasing?

eng_security: Don't revert. Add alias/compatibility layer in rolesync + add unit/integration checks. Also here's an audit query I'll run to find other impacted SAs: `resource.type="gcp_project" AND protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND protoPayload.request.@type:"type.googleapis.com/google.iam.v1.Policy"`

jason: Ticket closed after customer validated. Please attach the hotpatch command and INFRA-789 to the closure notes. Thanks everyone :+1: 

support_jen: Marking resolved in the ticket and adding link to INFRA-789. Will follow up with a short postmortem once the infra change is merged.
